messages:
maya: Heads-up — we need to coordinate a signed base-layer refresh. Security scan flagged CVE-2026-1432 in musl transitive dep used by our runtime images. Affected: runtime/generic:1.2, sandbox/builder:latest, test-runner. Proposal: rotate KMS signing key, rebuild minimal base images, push signed digests, and tighten RBAC so only build-bot role can sign. Can we align on sequence and windows?

ron: scope — do we need full rebuild of app images or just base layers?

maya: base-layer only ideally. We'll rebuild base, rebase app images in CI (no code changes). We want to avoid long downtime — canary to staging then gradual rollout to prod.

lin: audit logging checklist: export Cloud Audit Logs for kms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToSign and for registry.push events. Also enable object-level logs for the signed image storage bucket and forward to Splunk (index=security_audit).

security-bot: auto-alert: "VULN: CVE-2026-1432 detected in package musl (severity: HIGH). Affected images: runtime/generic:1.2, sandbox/builder. Recommended: rebuild with patched dependency."

devops-oncall: I can take the rebuild job. Proposed non-prod rebuild: Tue 03:00 UTC. Canary deploy to staging at 04:00 (10% of traffic), ramp 10 -> 50 -> 100 over 2 hours if no errors. Need the exact signing key rotation window.

maya: plan (high level):
1) Create new KMS key version for image signing.
2) Update IAM: remove broad signer rights, grant roles/cloudkms.signer to service account build-bot@redwood.internal.
3) Rebuild base images in ephemeral runners, sign with cosign, push signed manifests to registry with tag and immutable digest.
4) Enable registry-level verification in runtime: REDWOOD_VERIFY_SIGNATURE=true for canary cluster.
5) Monitor audit logs and errors, then roll to prod.

maya: quick commands we intend to run (example):
```
# create key version
gcloud kms keys versions create --key my-image-signing-key --location global --keyring infra-keys

# grant signer to build-bot
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding my-image-signing-key \
  --member=serviceAccount:build-bot@redwood.internal \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.signer

# sign image with cosign
COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/myproj/locations/global/keyRings/infra-keys/cryptoKeys/my-image-signing-key@1 gcr.io/redwood/runtime/generic:1.2
```

ron: for RBAC, we should avoid giving roles/cloudkms.admin. Only grant roles/cloudkms.signer at the key level and ensure build-bot cannot list keys or change IAM. Example IAM binding shown above is good.

lin: add to that — we should create a short-lived signer SA token for CI jobs, rotate it daily, and ensure audit logs capture token usage. Also add SIEM alert on any Unauthorized or SigningError events.

ops: runtime change: ensure the admission controller rejects unsigned images in prod once rollout is complete. For canary we'll flip admission config in staging only. Admission config snippet: 
```
admission:
  requireSignedImages: true
  signatureIssuer: gcpkms://projects/myproj/locations/global/keyRings/infra-keys/cryptoKeys/my-image-signing-key
```

devops-oncall: schedule confirmed. I'll create a runbook entry and a temporary thrash window: Tue 03:00-06:00 UTC. Canary plan: staging 03:30 (10%), prod canary 04:15 (10%), full 06:00 if green.

maya: vuln triage notes: patch verified in green branch. No functional changes expected. We will label the ticket CVE-2026-1432-IMG-REFRESH and link build logs + cosign verification.

ron: incident response Q: if signature verification fails at runtime, what fallback?

lin: fallback options: 1) allow fallback to previous signed digest (controlled rollback) via admission whitelist for previous-digest@sha256:..., 2) temporary disable verify flag and trigger emergency incident runbook. Prefer 1 for automated rollback. Make sure that rollback requires multi-sig approval (ops + security).

ops: I'll add the whitelist flow to the runbook and add a Splunk saved search: "signature_verification_failure" to page on error > 5/minute.

maya: approvals: Security (lin) — :thumbsup:? Ops (ops) :thumbsup:? Devops-oncall (devops-oncall) to confirm schedule.

lin: :thumbsup: from me.

ops: :thumbsup: I added runbook doc link: https://wiki.internal/redwood/runbooks/image-signing-refresh

devops-oncall: :thumbsup: schedule + runbook added. I'll post deploy start msg in #eng-runtime before kicking off.

maya: thanks — I'll create the ticket and assign tasks. Will post final checklist here once KMS key rotation is created.

security-bot: note: scheduled maintenance created: "Image signing + base-layer refresh" Tue 03:00-06:00 UTC.

ron: leaving a reminder: double-check that ECR/GCR replication preserves signatures for regional mirrors. If not, we need to re-sign per-region or update replication policy.

maya: good catch — I'll add replication verification step to the checklist.

(End of thread)
